title: Global financial crisis
notes: Commodity-price collapse and demand shock across PIC partners.

title: COVID-19 pandemic
notes: Border closures; tourism and logistics collapse. 2020 is the main trade-year shock.

title: PACER Plus in force
notes: Entered into force 13 December 2020; first full calendar year 2021. Fiji and PNG are not parties.

title: Solomon Islands switches recognition to China
notes: September 2019 switch from Taiwan to the PRC. Export share to China was already high (logs); imports are the clearer post-switch shift.

title: Kiribati switches recognition to China
notes: September 2019 switch from Taiwan to the PRC.

title: Nauru resumes diplomatic relations with China
notes: January 2024 switch from Taiwan to the PRC.

title: Regional Assistance Mission to Solomon Islands
notes: Australian-led RAMSI; security and aid footprint.

title: Honiara unrest 2021
notes: November 2021 riots after the diplomatic switch.

title: Australia sanctions after Fiji coup
notes: Travel bans and restricted engagement until 2014 elections.

title: Fiji Look North policy
notes: Period of heavier China engagement during Australia/NZ isolation.

title: Fiji elections and Australia normalisation
notes: Return to elected government; Australia restores broader ties.

title: Yazaki Samoa plant closure
notes: Automotive wiring plant had been a large Australia-oriented export.

title: Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai eruption
notes: January 2022 eruption and tsunami; reconstruction year.

title: PNG LNG exports begin
notes: First LNG cargoes 2014; reweights export partners and CWE.

title: APEC Papua New Guinea
notes: Host year; construction and official visits.

title: Reported China tourism restrictions
notes: Unofficial curbs on PRC tour groups after Palau-Taiwan ties held.

title: Nauru Regional Processing Centre reopened
notes: Reopened 2012; associated Australian-funded activity and imports.
